dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do they call you the "Master of Anti-Self-Termination"?

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: That's all because of a math problem I posed. The problem goes like this: a group of soldiers refuses to surrender, viewing it as a matter of honor. So, they decide to come up with a set of rules to...

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: ...determine who among them would end the humiliation, and for whom. So, what manners of rules would ensure that one would be the last man standing?

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: It's probably due to this purely mathematical problem.
